rationale: The platform is described as aggregating retail data in the cloud and organizing, analyzing, and displaying visualizations for a unified real-time store and shopper view, with no AI signal.
evidence_spans: organizes, analyzes and displays visualizations of massive volumes of diverse retail data
The software aggregates information from all your stores on the cloud, providing a unified and instant view of your stores and shoppers, across your chain-all in real time
conflict_response: The concrete cloud aggregation, visualization, and unified-view functions support a conventional negative. The word analyzes is not accompanied by prediction, learning, or another AI-dependent capability, so it does not by itself make the negative weak.
